summary: Fate Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market (ATM) equity program of up to $100,000,000 of common stock sold through Leerink Partners as sales agent under a November 5, 2026 sales agreement. Shares trade on Nasdaq under FATE; last reported price was $2.09 on November 4, 2026. Leerink receives up to 3.0% commission and acts on commercially reasonable efforts with no escrow. The shelf registration expires November 27, 2026, with a replacement S-3 planned. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and overhang.
